WITH site_averages AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS avg_faces
  FROM sites AS s
  JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(m.facetfaces) AS avg_faces
  FROM scanmesh AS m
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_faces) AS avg_site_faces
  FROM site_averages
  WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY entrystat
),
kept AS (
  SELECT sa.avg_faces, b.avg_faces AS baseline_faces, sta.avg_site_faces AS status_avg_faces
  FROM site_averages AS sa
  JOIN status_averages AS sta ON sta.entrystat = sa.entrystat
  CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
  WHERE sa.entrystat IS NOT NULL
    AND sa.avg_faces > sta.avg_site_faces
    AND b.avg_faces IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(avg_faces) AS avg_kept_site_faces,
       AVG(avg_faces - baseline_faces) AS avg_excess_overall_baseline,
       AVG(avg_faces - status_avg_faces) AS avg_excess_over_status_average
FROM kept;

assumptions.assumption: Sites without any matched mesh record are excluded because they have no site average; AVG ignores NULL facetfaces, and the baseline is over matched records with non-NULL facetfaces.
